title: Grateful Dead Live at Santa Cruz County Fairgrounds on 1983-09-24
lineage: Master Cassette (Nakamichi LX-5) > MOTU M4 > Macbook Pro > Audacity (.wav 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition 2023 > TLH flac2496
source: Scott Wiseman's Master Audience Cassettes; AKG SE-5E mics with CE-1 cardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII 90)

ai_review.summary: Clear recording with strong dynamic range and separation, though reviewers focus on tape quality rather than specific performance details
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise Scott Wiseman’s taping, highlighting excellent dynamic range and instrument separation that give the show a vivid sound. One reviewer shares a personal story about introducing his future wife to the Dead, but neither review mentions particular songs or musical highlights, leaving the performance itself largely undescribed.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are highly positive (4 and 5 stars) and emphasize strong recording quality; lack of detailed musical commentary keeps the show rating moderate, resulting in an overall rating around 4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note good dynamic range and separation, describing the tape as consistently impressive with no reported flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific musical details or set flow mentioned in the reviews.
